Well that’s easy.  We do it to show and promote the use of data.  GeoFindIT is a showcase for GeoDirectory, Ireland’s most accurate address and location database with 2.2 million residential and business leads. We are passionate about data and believe everyone, whether in the community or business can benefit from better use and interaction with data.  The GeoFindIT App enables us to show you and demonstrate how beneficial data can be.
